August 15

The Assumption

By Father John Banister Tabb (1845–1909)

A feast in the Roman and Greek churches commemorating the resurrection of the Virgin and her miraculous ascent into Heaven. It is celebrated on August 15.
N
OR
 Bethlehem nor Nazareth
Apart from Mary’s care;
Nor heaven itself a home for Him
Were not His mother there.
